info.title: meshy/meshy-7.1
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "meshy/meshy-7.1", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description:
The Comfy Router input schema for `meshy/meshy-7.1` text-to-3d.
meshy-7.1 (PN-1223) is the tier every conditional option is available on -- Ultra generation (`ultra_mode`, preview mode), the full `standard`/`2k`/`4k` geometry range, and the full `2k`/`4k`/`8k` texture range -- so it narrows nothing and is the shared shape in MeshyTextTo3DInputs under its own id.

MeshyArtStyle.description: Describe your desired art style of the object.

MeshyPoseMode.description: Specify the pose mode for the generated model.

MeshySymmetryMode.description: Controls symmetry behavior during model generation.

MeshyTextTo3DInputs.description:
The model-agnostic Comfy Router input shape for the `meshy/*` text-to-3d models: either a PREVIEW body (`mode: preview`, which generates the untextured mesh) or a REFINE body (`mode: refine`, which textures a preview task's output).
It composes the same two branches the v1 `POST /proxy/meshy/openapi/v2/text-to-3d` body does, differing only in `ai_model`: on this route the model comes from the path (`/v2/models/meshy/{model}`), so `ai_model` may be omitted or sent as null and Comfy Router writes the path's model into it before the call is forwarded.

MeshyTextTo3DPreviewInputs.description:
The meshy text-to-3d PREVIEW fields, shared by the `preview` branch of the v1 `POST /proxy/meshy/openapi/v2/text-to-3d` body and the `preview` branch of the Comfy Router input schema for the `meshy/*` models.
The two surfaces share every property and both `required` entries. They differ only in `ai_model`: the v1 body restates it as a fixed enum, because that route carries no path segment to supply the model from, while on the Comfy Router route the path supplies it.

ai_model.description: The Meshy model to run. On the Comfy Router route this is supplied by the path (`/v2/models/meshy/{model}`) and may be omitted or sent as null; Router writes the path's model here after validation. On the v1 /proxy route see MeshyTextTo3DPreviewRequest, which constrains it to MeshyAiModel.

geometry_resolution.description: Geometry resolution of the generated mesh. 2k and 4k run the Ultra pass for finer surface detail. 2k and 4k require ai_model meshy-7.1 or latest.

is_a_t_pose.description: Deprecated. Use pose_mode instead. Whether to generate the model in an A/T pose.

mode.description: This field should be set to "preview" when creating a preview task.

moderation.description: When true, input content will be screened for potentially harmful content.

prompt.description: Describe what kind of object the 3D model is. Maximum 800 characters.

should_remesh.description: Controls whether to enable the remesh phase. When false, returns highest-precision triangular mesh. Defaults to true for Meshy 5 and false for Meshy 6 and 7.

target_polycount.description: Specify the target number of polygons in the generated model. Valid range is 100 to 300,000.

ultra_mode.description: Deprecated. Use geometry_resolution instead; true is equivalent to geometry_resolution 2k. Only supported when ai_model is meshy-7, meshy-7.1 or latest. The exception is meshy-7: geometry_resolution 2k requires meshy-7.1 or latest, so on meshy-7 ultra_mode true is the way to request the Ultra pass.

MeshyTextTo3DRefineInputs.description:
The meshy text-to-3d REFINE fields, shared by the `refine` branch of the v1 `POST /proxy/meshy/openapi/v2/text-to-3d` body and the `refine` branch of the Comfy Router input schema for the `meshy/*` models.
The two surfaces share every property and both `required` entries. They differ only in `ai_model`: the v1 body restates it as a fixed enum, because that route carries no path segment to supply the model from, while on the Comfy Router route the path supplies it.

ai_model.description: The Meshy model to run. On the Comfy Router route this is supplied by the path (`/v2/models/meshy/{model}`) and may be omitted or sent as null; Router writes the path's model here after validation. On the v1 /proxy route see MeshyTextTo3DRefineRequest, which constrains it to MeshyAiModel.

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR Maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to the base color. Note that enable_pbr should be set to false when using Sculpture style.

mode.description: This field should be set to "refine" when creating a refine task.

moderation.description: When true, input content will be screened for potentially harmful content.

preview_task_id.description: The corresponding preview task id. The status of the given preview task must be SUCCEEDED.

texture_image_url.description: Provide a 2d image to guide the texturing process. Supports .jpg, .jpeg, .png formats or base64-encoded data URI.

texture_prompt.description: Provide an additional text prompt to guide the texturing process. Maximum 800 characters.

texture_resolution.description: Texture resolution of the generated textures. One of 2k, 4k or 8k. 4k and 8k require ai_model meshy-6, meshy-7, meshy-7.1 or latest.

MeshyTopology.description: Specify the topology of the generated model.
